articles.title: Mammoth at Blue Jackets projected lineups
Sabres at Blue Jackets projected lineups
Blue Jackets place defenseman Ivan Provorov on Injured Reserve

away.summary: The Utah Mammoth are coming off a 6-0 shutout win over the Chicago Blackhawks in their season opener, with Sebastian Cossa earning the start and making his Mammoth debut. The team is projected to use the same lineup that defeated Chicago, with no additional injuries or scratches reported beyond Maveric Lamoureux (shoulder) and the previously scratched trio. Utah will look to build on their strong start as they face the Columbus Blue Jackets on the road.

home.summary: The Columbus Blue Jackets are set to use the same lineup from their 6-3 win over the Buffalo Sabres on Thursday, with no changes indicated in the projected lineup. The team remains without key defensemen Ivan Provorov (lower body, on IR), Damon Severson (shoulder), Dante Fabbro (broken hand), and Isac Lundestrom (lower body), all listed as week-to-week. Coach Rick Bowness noted that Dmitri Voronkov and Conor Garland may swap lines depending on in-game situations.
